sok.text: The All-Consuming Oni of Chaos, an oni manifested by Hidetsugu's call, is found by Toshi eating Minamo's library, where Toshi meets Hidetsugu and refuses to commit fully to the Hyozan Reckoners, becoming his enemy.
Toshi uses Night's Reach's powers to chase the oni off at Minamo, drawing Hidetsugu's ire.
Hidetsugu then devours the failed oni, becoming the most formidable demonic entity, until Kyodai imprisons him in the spirit realm.
